question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

You__ hit the nail on the head__ with this colour of wallpaper for the living room; it looks better than I expected.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e., "Identify something exactly right".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"You hit the nail on the head"** means to identify or describe something perfectly or exactly. (ठीक पहचान करना)

 
 
• **Example:** When you said the team needs better coordination, you really hit the nail on the head.
 
 
 
• **"Hit the nail on the head"** in English refers to being accurate or precise, especially in understanding or solving a problem. In Hindi, it means "सही बात कहना या करना".
 
 
• **Example:** By suggesting this strategy, you’ve hit the nail on the head regarding increasing customer engagement.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hit the floor **(फर्श पर गिरना): This phrase usually means to fall down or to dance energetically.

 
 
• **Example:** The moment the music started, everyone hit the floor and began dancing.
 
 
 
• **Hit the wall **(किसी बाधा का सामना करना): This means to reach a point where you cannot continue or progress further.
 
 
• **Example:** After working for 12 hours straight, I hit the wall and couldn't concentrate anymore.
 
 
 
• **Analyse and understand the situation** (स्थिति का विश्लेषण और समझना): While this phrase is related to thinking critically, it does not convey the exact meaning of the idiom "hit the nail on the head."
 
 
• **Example:** It’s important to analyse and understand the situation before making any decisions.
